title: Focused Breath Awareness - Observe your natural breath while repeating the mantra Hong-Sau.
steps: 1. Find a comfortable spot to sit quietly and watch your natural breath.
2. As you inhale, mentally say 'Hong' (rhymes with song).
3. As you exhale, mentally say 'Sau' (saw).
4. Let the breath be natural, without controlling it.
5. When the mind wanders, gently return to the mantra.

title: Breath of Fire - Breathe with equal inhale and exhale through the nose, feeling your naval naturally pump with rhythm.
steps: 1. Sit with legs crossed or comfortably in a chair.
2. Breathe equal inhale and exhale through the nose.
3. Take your time getting to a perfect rhythm of equal inhale and exhale completely through your nose.
4. Youâ€™ll feel your naval naturally pump.

title: Alternate Nostril Breath - Balance the breath and mind by alternating between left and right nostrils, visualizing a rainbow flowing with each cycle.
steps: 1. Sit with legs crossed or comfortably in a chair.
2. Place your thumb above the right nostril and ring finger above the left. Use these fingers to alternately block each nostril.
3. Support your right elbow with your left hand if needed, but keep chest unrestricted.
4. Close right nostril with thumb, inhale deeply through left nostril for 5 seconds.
5. Open right nostril, close left, exhale through right for 5 seconds.
6. Inhale through right nostril for 5 seconds.
7. Close right nostril, exhale through left nostril for 5 seconds.
8. Visualize a rainbow flowing up one side on inhale, down the other side on exhale.

title: Siri Gaitri Mantra - Tune in to this mantraâ€™s vibration to uplift and reset.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably with your spine straight, cross-legged or in a chair with feet flat. Rest your hands on your knees or lap.
2. Close your eyes gently and take a few deep breaths to center yourself.
3. When youâ€™re ready press play to begin chanting. RA MA DA SA, SA SAY SO HUNG
4. Let each sound resonate fully. Feel the vibration in your body.
5. As you chant, focus awareness on the energy centers: Ra â€“ root, Ma â€“ sacral, Da â€“ solar plexus, Sa â€“ heart/throat, Say â€“ third eye, So â€“ crown, Hung â€“ returning energy down to root.
6. Continue for 8 minutes, breathing naturally, letting the mantra carry your attention upward and back down.
7. At the end, take a deep breath in, hold gently, then exhale and sit in silence for a few moments.

title: Sat Nam Mantra - Return to authentic self using this sound current.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably with your spine straight, cross-legged or in a chair with your feet grounded. Rest your hands on your knees or in your lap.
2. Close your eyes and take a few slow breaths, allowing your body to settle.
3. Begin chanting: SAT NAM (pronounced: 'Sut Naam').
4. As you chant Sat, feel the vibration rising from the base of your spine â€” a call to truth. As you chant Nam, let the sound flow forward, affirming your authentic self.
5. Allow each repetition to sink in and resonate through your whole body.
6. Chant for 7 minutes, reaffirming: 'Truth is my Identity.'
7. To end, take a deep breath in. Rest in the quiet presence of your authentic self.

title: Shamata Meditation - Create calm and concentration by resting the mind and bringing tranquility to the body.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably with spine straight, cross-legged or in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Rest hands on your knees or in your lap.
2. Gently close the eyes or soften the gaze.
3. Take a few slow, deep breaths. Allow your body to relax while remaining alert. Release any unnecessary tension in the face, shoulders, or hands.
4. Bring awareness fully to the inhale and exhale.
5. When thoughts arise or attention wanders, notice, then return to your breath.
6. Continue resting awareness, breathing naturally. Each time the mind drifts, return again to your breath.
7. Continue for set time.

title: Visualization Breath - Circulate energy up and down the spine to clear blockages and awaken inner peace.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably with a straight spine.
2. Inhale slowly through the nose and imagine your breath as golden light rising from the base of your spine to the crown of your head.
3. Exhale and feel the golden energy flow gently down the spine to the tailbone.
4. Affirm with each breath: 'I am a channel for divine energy.'

title: Om Mantra - A rhythmic breath and sound practice that uses the vibration of Om to deepen connection to source.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably with spine straight, cross-legged or in a chair with feet grounded. You may also lie down if you can maintain awareness. Rest hands on knees or in your lap.
2. Gently close your eyes and take a few slow breaths.
3. Focus on the inner ears, as though listening inside.
4. Inhale deeply through the nose. Open your mouth slightly in the shape of an 'O.'
5. Exhale with a long, steady 'Ooooommmmmmmmmmâ€¦' flowing from the chest.
6. Feel the vibration in the head and body.
7. Inhale fully through the nose â†’ chant Om on the exhale â†’ pause in silence.
8. Continue for the set time. End with a few quiet breaths.

title: Tighten and Release - A quick reset that uses full-body contraction to discharge stuck energy and release tension.
steps: 1. Stand with feet hip-width apart or sit upright in a chair. Keep your spine tall and shoulders relaxed.
2. Take a deep breath in through the nose. As you inhale, tense every muscle in your body from the feet upward: clench fists, squeeze legs and core, tighten face and jaw, engage the whole body.
3. Maintain the breath and the tension for 5â€“10 seconds.
4. Exhale forcefully through the mouth. Let all tension go in a sigh, shake, or loud 'HA!'
5. Rest for a moment. Notice sensations like tingling, lightness, or ease.
6. Continue the cycle for the set time.

title: Psychic Breath - A controlled yogic breathing practice that creates a gentle ocean-like sound calming the nervous system.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably with spine straight. Close your eyes and relax your body.
2. Place the tongue in khechari mudra â€” folding it upward and backward so the underside touches the upper palate. Keep lips softly closed.
3. Allow the breath to become slow, even, and rhythmic.
4. Imagine the breath flowing in and out through the throat itself, as though through a small opening.
5. Exhale gently as if fogging up a mirror, but with the mouth closed. Listen for a soft whispering or ocean-like sound in the throat.
6. Keep this gentle throat contraction on both inhalation and exhalation.
7. Allow the abdomen to contract naturally on the exhale.
8. Continue for set time, letting the sound anchor your focus inward.
9. With additional practice, combine with jalandhar bandha (chin lock) and moola bandha (root lock) for deeper energetic effects.

title: Humming Bee Breath - A steady humming sound to soothe the nervous system, quiet the mind, and direct awareness inward.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably with spine straight, cross-legged, or sitting upright in a chair. Rest hands on your knees. Relax the body fully.
2. Keep the mouth closed and teeth slightly apart throughout the practice.
3. Gently plug ears with index or middle fingers.
4. Bring attention to the center of the head, at the third eye.
5. Inhale deeply through the nose. On exhalation, produce a steady humming sound like a bee.
6. Let the hum be continuous, then inhale again without strain and repeat. Maintain focus on the sound and vibration.
7. Continue for set time.

title: Coherent Reset - Calm the body, clear the mind, and return to safety.
steps: 1. Sit comfortably or lay down with spine straight.
2. Place one hand on your heart and one on your belly. Feel your feet or seat pressing into the ground.
3. Feel a heart-based emotion like gratitude, peace, or love.
4. Say silently or aloud: 'I choose to return to my body. I am safe to be here now.'
5. Deeply inhale and exhale through the nose.
6. Continue for set time.

title: Body Shake - An intentional movement that helps release stored tension and emotion creating more freedom and flow in the body.
steps: 1. Find a safe, open space where you can move freely. Stand with feet grounded.
2. Take a few deep breaths and set an intention such as: 'I allow all energy to move through me and release with ease now.'
3. Allow your body to start shaking freely. Sway or bounce gently through the knees.
4. If it feels natural, let it build into free dance or flowing movement.
5. Breath is rhythmic (inhale through nose, exhale with sound like 'Ah!').
6. Repeat mentally: 'My body knows how to release and reset.' / 'I am safe to let go.' / 'Energy flows freely through me.'
7. Gradually reduce the intensity of movement. Come to stillness.
8. Place one hand on the heart, one on the belly. Take 3 deep breaths.
9. Notice sensations, warmth, tingling, or spaciousness in the body.
